pharmaMaterial.name: Pharmaceutical and Health Care Material
pharmaMaterial.description: A raw or processed substance used in the manufacture of medicines, medical devices, supplements, and health care products.

personalCareMaterial.name: Personal and Home Care Material
personalCareMaterial.description: A raw or processed substance used in formulating personal care products (skincare, haircare, oral care) and home care products (detergents, cleaners, disinfectants). These materials provide cleansing, conditioning, and protective functions.

foodProduct.name: Food Product
foodProduct.description: A finished, processed, or packaged item intended for human consumption that has undergone preparation, combination, or transformation from raw ingredients.

foodIngredient.name: Food Ingredient
foodIngredient.description: Any substance that is added to food during production, processing, or preparation to achieve a desired effect such as preservation, flavor, texture, or appearance.

chemicalMaterial.name: Chemical
chemicalMaterial.description: A substance with a defined molecular composition used in industrial processes, manufacturing, agriculture and research. Chemicals serve as raw materials, reagents, solvents, and intermediates across virtually all industries.

agroProduct.name: Agro-Product
agroProduct.description: A raw or semi-processed product derived from agricultural activities including farming, forestry, and fisheries. Agro-products serve as food, medicinal, feed, fuel, and industrial raw materials for downstream processing.

packagingMaterial.name: Cosmetic and Food Packaging
packagingMaterial.description: Containers and materials designed to hold, protect, and present cosmetic and food products. Packaging ensures product stability, hygiene, and brand appeal while enabling precise dispensing and consumer convenience.
